components.name: battery_holder_4aa
components.part_reference: Generic 2x2 holder for four AA cells in series, with leads
components.notes: Body 62.65 x 57.40 x 14.80 mm, 152.4 mm AWG26 leads (reseller listing; 58 x 63 x 16 mm in the second source). 4 x 1.5 V alkaline cells = 6 V nominal; evaluated as an ideal source.

components.notes: DO-41 outline: body 4.10-5.20 mm long, 2.00-2.70 mm diameter, leads 0.70-0.90 mm diameter and at least 25.40 mm long each; band marks the cathode. VF 1.1 V max at 1.0 A, IF(AV) 1.0 A.
